run_doctest_data_members: run the doctest suite that tests Boost.Python static and instance data member bindings
test_boost_python_static_members: test static data member read-only and read-write access through the Var class
test_boost_python_instance_members: test instance data member access on Var, X, and Y objects from data_members_ext
test_boost_python_member_assignment: test assigning values to read-write static members and verifying propagation across all accessors
test_boost_python_bool_member: test setting and getting a boolean member q on a Y instance
